blocks.p: These Terms of Use (the "Terms") govern access to and use of the Let's Out mobile application (the "Application"), published by FIHODECORP SARL (the "Publisher").

Let's Out is a social platform that lets users create and join local group events, finance these events through shared pots, sell and buy tickets, and connect with other users who share the same interests.

By creating an account, ticking the acceptance box or using the Application, the user declares that they have read, understood and accepted without reservation these Terms and the Privacy Policy (Part II). If the user does not accept these terms, they must refrain from using the Application.

ul: User: any person holding a Let's Out account.
Organizer: the user who creates an event, a shared pot or a ticketing service.
Participant: the user who joins an event, contributes to a shared pot or buys a ticket.
Local host: the user, private individual or professional, who offers a venue or space to host an event.
Event: any outing, activity, meetup or gathering published on the Application.
Shared pot: a collection of contributions among the participants of an event, intended to finance that event's expenses.
Ticketing: a service for selling access tickets to an event through the Application.
Payment provider: any payment aggregator, mobile money operator, bank or financial institution involved in processing payments, including FedaPay.
Business day: Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays in Benin.

cgu.title: Access to the service and user account

blocks.p: The Application is reserved for natural persons aged at least 18 and legally capable. Minors are prohibited from creating an account, contributing to a shared pot or buying a ticket. The Publisher may request any proof of age and delete without notice any account whose holder is a minor.

ul: The information provided must be accurate, complete and kept up to date.
Each person may hold only one account. Identity theft is prohibited.
The user is responsible for the confidentiality of their credentials and for any activity carried out from their account.
In the event of loss, theft or fraudulent use of their credentials, the user must immediately inform the Publisher at fihodecorp@gmail.com.

blocks.p: For the safety of the community and to comply with regulations, the Publisher may require verification of the user's identity, in particular before creating a paid event, opening a ticketing service, or processing a withdrawal request. Refusing this verification may result in these services being refused or suspended.

The Publisher provides a technical platform for connecting people. It is neither the organizer, co-organizer nor seller of the events published by users, and is not a party to the agreements concluded between organizers, local hosts and participants.

The Publisher is neither a bank nor a credit institution. Payments are processed by Payment providers. Sums held for shared pots and ticketing do not constitute bank deposits, bear no interest and generate no return for the user.
The organizer is solely responsible for their event. They undertake to:

ul: provide accurate information (date, venue, programme, price, number of places, cancellation terms) and update it without delay;
comply with applicable laws and regulations, in particular regarding safety, administrative authorizations, sale of alcohol, noise, taxation and copyright;
ensure the safety of participants and take out the insurance needed for the event;
not organize any event that is unlawful, discriminatory, dangerous or contrary to public decency.

blocks.p: The local host acts entirely independently. They guarantee that they have the right to host the event at the proposed venue, that the venue matches its description and complies with safety rules, and that they respect the rights of neighbours and third parties. A "verified" badge or mention only reflects the Publisher's check of certain information and is neither a certification nor a guarantee of the venue's safety or quality.

Real-life meetups carry risks. The participant remains the sole judge of their participation, must exercise caution (especially at a first meeting) and is encouraged to report any inappropriate behaviour to the Publisher. In case of danger, they must contact the competent authorities immediately.

The shared pot lets the participants of an event pool funds to finance that event's expenses (transport, catering, rental, entrance fees, equipment, etc.). The purpose, target amount and validation rules are set by the organizer when creating the shared pot and are visible to all participants before any contribution.

In the current version of the Application, collected funds are held by FIHODECORP SARL in an account dedicated to shared pots, separate from its own operating funds, as a temporary trusted third party, pending a partnership with an approved financial institution. The Publisher refrains from using these funds for any purpose other than those provided for in these Terms. Users will be informed of any change in the holding arrangement.

ul: Contributions are free and voluntary, subject to any minimum amount set by the organizer.
The applicable commission is clearly displayed before payment is confirmed.
A confirmed contribution can only be withdrawn in the cases provided for in these Terms (event cancellation, unused balance, proven technical error or decision of the Publisher).
Every expense is submitted by the organizer with the supporting documents requested by the Application (quote, invoice, supplier name, amount).
Disbursement only takes place after the expense has been validated according to the rule set when the shared pot was created (approval threshold of participants).
Each participant can view in real time the contributions received, the expenses submitted, validated or rejected, and the available balance.
The Publisher may refuse or suspend a disbursement in case of serious doubt about its regularity, a dispute between participants, suspected fraud or an order from an authority.

blocks.p: If the event is cancelled, postponed without the participants' agreement, or cannot take place, contributions are refunded in full to the contributors, including the Publisher's commission, within a maximum of seven (7) business days from the cancellation being established. Any non-refundable fees charged by a Payment provider, where they exist, are indicated before payment.

After the event, the unspent balance is, according to the group's decision made in the Application, either paid back in proportion to the contributions or allocated to another use validated by the group. If no decision is made within thirty (30) days after the event, the balance is paid back in proportion to the contributions.

It is prohibited to use a shared pot to collect funds unrelated to an event, for an unlawful purpose, for undeclared donations, to finance illegal activities, or for a use other than the one announced. Any misappropriation of funds may lead to account suspension, freezing of the sums concerned, and civil and criminal proceedings.
Ticketing lets an organizer sell tickets for their event and a user buy them through the Application. The ticket is personal and takes the form of a unique code or QR code, presented at the entrance.

The organizer sets the price, the number of tickets and the conditions of the event. They are the seller of the ticket and solely responsible for the service, its content, its holding and their tax obligations. The Publisher only acts as a technical intermediary for payment collection and access management.

blocks.h: 8.3 Purchase and use of the ticket

ul: The purchase is firm and final once payment is confirmed, subject to the refund cases provided below.
The ticket is nominative or linked to the buyer's account. It can only be used once: any ticket already scanned is invalidated.
Reselling tickets above their original price, or copying or forging a ticket, is prohibited and results in cancellation of the ticket without refund and suspension of the account.
If the organizer cancels the event, tickets are refunded in full, commission included, within a maximum of seven (7) business days.
If the event is postponed, the ticket remains valid for the new date. A buyer who cannot attend may request a refund within seven (7) days of the postponement being announced.

Unless otherwise stated before purchase, a buyer who does not show up or no longer wishes to attend is not entitled to any refund. The organizer may offer a more favourable refund policy, which must be stated on the event page.

blocks.p: The net proceeds of ticket sales (after deduction of the Publisher's commission) are made available to the organizer after the event has taken place, unless special conditions are displayed in the Application. The organizer requests payment in accordance with article 10. The Publisher may defer the payout in case of a dispute, a report, a high proportion of refund requests or suspected fraud.
Use of the Application is free for creating an account, browsing and joining a free event. The shared pot and ticketing services are subject to the following commissions:

ul: Commissions are deducted from the sums collected. The net amount available to the organizer is displayed in the Application. Any applicable taxes are indicated when they are added.
Processing fees may be charged by Payment providers (mobile money operators, bank cards). Where they apply, they are indicated before payment is confirmed.

The Publisher may change its commissions for the future, with at least fifteen (15) days' prior notice in the Application. New commissions do not apply to shared pots already open or to tickets already sold.

blocks.p: Payments are made using the methods offered in the Application (mobile money, bank card or others). They are processed by Payment providers, whose own terms apply. The Publisher does not store users' full banking details.

An organizer who wishes to receive funds to which they are entitled (a validated shared pot expense, net ticketing proceeds) requests it in the Application. Payment is made exclusively to the account holder, or to the designated and validated supplier in the case of a shared pot expense, to an account or mobile money number in their name. Payments to unidentified third parties are refused.

blocks.p: These timeframes are indicative. They may be extended in the event of additional identity or document checks, anti-fraud controls, disputes, public holidays, unavailability or slowdown of a Payment provider or telephone operator, or a request from an authority. The Publisher cannot be held liable for delays attributable to these third parties, but undertakes to inform the user concerned and to act diligently.

Any payment error, double charge or dispute must be reported to the Publisher as soon as possible and no later than thirty (30) days after the transaction, with supporting evidence. A user who abusively or fraudulently initiates a dispute with their bank or operator exposes themselves to suspension of their account and recovery of the sums due.

cgu.title: Fight against fraud, money laundering and terrorist financing

blocks.p: The Publisher applies due diligence measures in accordance with the regulations in force in Benin and in the WAEMU area. To this end, it may: request proof of identity and of the origin or destination of funds, limit or cap amounts, delay, refuse or freeze a transaction or withdrawal, close an account, and report any suspicious transaction to the competent authorities, without informing the user where the law prohibits it.

Each event may have an attendance QR code. Participants are invited to scan it on arrival to confirm their attendance. A registered participant who does not show up, without having notified the organizer at least two (2) hours before the start of the event, is recorded as an unjustified absence, which may lower their reliability score. After several unjustified absences, access to certain events may be subject to the organizer's approval or temporarily suspended.

After an event, participants whose attendance is confirmed can rate each other on punctuality, attitude and reliability. The overall score is visible on the user's profile and may be taken into account for access to certain events. Ratings must reflect a real experience. The following are prohibited: favour ratings between linked accounts, retaliatory ratings, fake ratings and any manipulation. The user may contest a rating with the Publisher, which reviews it in good faith and may discard it if it is clearly abusive.
The user undertakes to use the Application in compliance with the law and with respect for other members. The following are prohibited in particular:

ul: harassment, threats, hateful, discriminatory, defamatory or insulting remarks, or unsolicited sexual remarks;
content that is unlawful, violent, pornographic, or infringes the rights of third parties (image, privacy, intellectual property);
fraud, identity theft, creating fake events, scams and soliciting money outside the Application;
collecting other users' personal data for unauthorized purposes, unauthorized commercial solicitation and spam;
any attempt at hacking, automated data extraction, circumventing security measures or disrupting the service;
diverting payment outside the Application to avoid commissions.

blocks.p: Every user can report content, a profile or an event from the Application. The Publisher reviews reports within a reasonable time and may, without notice, remove content, restrict a feature, or suspend or delete an account. The Publisher has no general obligation to monitor content published by users and is not its author.

By attending an event, the participant is informed of this and, unless they object to the organizer or the Publisher before or during the event, authorizes the use of their image in this context, free of charge, for the duration of the Application's promotion. Anyone may at any time request the removal of content in which they appear by writing to fihodecorp@gmail.com. Organizers undertake to inform participants that images are being captured and to respect their objection.

Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.

The user agrees to receive communications about their account and transactions by in-app notification, email or SMS. Data recorded in the systems of the Publisher and its Payment providers is authoritative, unless proven otherwise, as to the existence and content of the transactions carried out.

privacy.title: Public profile, ratings and automated processing

blocks.p: Your public profile and reliability score are visible to other users, which is essential for trust within the community. The score is calculated from confirmed attendance, punctuality, behaviour and ratings received. Our event suggestions are based on your interests and area. No decision producing significant legal effects for you is taken solely by automated means without the possibility of review: you can request a human review at any time by writing to fihodecorp@gmail.com.

Location is only used if you allow it in your device settings, to show nearby events and facilitate check-in. We do not track your movements outside the Application. You can withdraw this permission at any time in your device settings; the Application remains usable by entering your city manually.

We send you notifications necessary for the service (new participants, messages, event reminders, expense validations, refunds, security). You can manage non-essential notifications in the Application or device settings, and unsubscribe from any promotional communication.

Images captured during events are processed in accordance with article 15 of the Terms. You can object to their use or request their removal by writing to fihodecorp@gmail.com. We process your request as soon as possible and remove the content under our control, without being able to guarantee the deletion of copies already shared by third parties.
The Application is prohibited to persons under 18. If we find that an account belongs to a minor, we delete it along with the associated data. If you believe a minor has provided data, contact us.

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures: encryption of communications, authentication, access control, separation of fund accounts, backups, logging and training of authorized personnel. Sensitive payment data is processed by our Payment providers and is not stored in plain text by the Publisher. As no system is infallible, we encourage you to choose a strong password, not to share it and to protect your device.

In the event of a data breach likely to create a risk to your rights and freedoms, we inform the competent data protection authority within the legal timeframes and, where the risk is high, the users concerned as soon as possible, specifying the measures taken.
You have the following rights over your data:

ul: Access: obtain a copy of the data concerning you and information about its processing.
Rectification: have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected.
Erasure: request the deletion of your data, subject to legal retention periods.
Objection: object to processing based on legitimate interest, and at any time to direct marketing.
Restriction: request the suspension of processing in the cases provided for by law.
Portability: receive your data in a structured and commonly used format.
Withdrawal of consent: at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.
Human review: of any automated decision concerning you.

blocks.p: To exercise your rights, write to fihodecorp@gmail.com stating the purpose of your request. We may ask for proof of identity to prevent identity theft. We respond within a maximum of thirty (30) days. If you believe your rights are not being respected, you can lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Authority of Benin (APDP).

The Application uses technical identifiers that are strictly necessary for its operation (session, security, preferences) and for audience and stability measurement. It does not use third-party advertising trackers. You can limit certain identifiers in your device settings, at the risk of degrading some features.

We may update this Policy to reflect changes in the service, our providers or the law. Substantial changes are notified to you under the conditions of article 23. The date of the latest version appears in the Application.
